claim: GPS satellites orbit at about 20,200 km (12,550 miles) above Earth
quote: GPS satellites fly in medium Earth orbit at an altitude of approximately 20,200 Kilometers [#] .

claim: Each GPS satellite circles the Earth twice a day
quote: Each satellite circles the Earth twice a day.

claim: More than 30 GPS navigation satellites operate today (the constellation was designed for 24)
quote: Over 30 GPS navigation satellites are whizzing around the world, orbiting at an altitude of 20,200 Kilometers [#] , to help us find our way.

claim: GPS signals travel at the speed of light (the SI-defined constant, 299,792,458 m/s)
hedge: the speed of light is a defined constant (exactly 299,792,458 m/s by the SI definition); the film states it as a definition, not a measurement, and computes with it via sympy
